join.title: Join the group
join.intro: Enter the invitation code the admin gave you, and your name.
join.notValid: That code does not work. Ask the admin for a new invitation.
join.nameNotUsable: This name cannot be used. It needs at least one visible character, and no hidden characters.
join.notSaved: The server could not be reached, so nothing was saved. Try again.
join.signedOut: This phone is no longer signed in to the group.

member.title: You are in the group
member.status: This phone is signed in to the group.
member.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Try again in a moment.

invite.title: New invitation
invite.expires: The code can be used once, until {{date}}.

members.title: Members
members.confirmText: Remove {{name}} from the group? It takes effect at once: {{name}} gets no more alerts, and needs a new invitation to join again.
members.removed: {{name}} has been removed from the group.
members.refused: The server refused the removal. Nobody was removed.
